create_Variadic_signature: create a variadic signature type using Variadic[int] to match any number of int arguments
create_Variadic_tuple_signature: create a variadic signature type using Variadic[(int, str)] to match any number of int or str arguments

test_Variadic_equality: test equality between two variadic signature types using the __eq__ method
